newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle trade at $67, off $1 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle trade at $67, off $1 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was rather slow, with slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 per cwt lower, USDA said.
Inquiry fair, demand rather light. Sales confirmed on 2,100 slaughter steers and 2,600 slaughter heifers Thursday.
For the week to date 75,700 head confirmed including 29,000 head or about 38 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Chhoice 2-3 1050-1175 lbs 67.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1080 lbs 67.00.
Wk to date - 75,700 week ago - 94,200 year ago - 44,800
